text.en: This Order may be cited as the Criminal Law (Preventive Detention) Act Order, 2012. of new section 1A into Chapter 150.

The Criminal Law {Preventive Detention) Act, in this Order referred to as the amended by inserting the following new section immediately after "Interpretation. 1A. In this Act, unless the context otherwise requiresmeans the Narcotics Control Bureau; of the Bureau", "Deputy Director of the Bureau" and Director of the Bureau" mean, respectively, the Director, the Director and an Assistant Director of the Narcotics Control appointed under section 2A of the Misuse of Drugs Act (Chapter 27); means the Minister of Home Affairs; the Bureau" has the same meaning assigned to it under the Misuse of Drugs Act {Chapter 27).". of section 2.
Section 4 of the Act is amended, in subsection (1), by inserting "or the Bureau" immediately after "police" in the fourth line. of section 5.
Section 6 of the Act is amended, in subsection (1), by inserting "or officer of the Bureau in the district" immediately after "district" in the third line. of section 8.
Section 8 of the Act is amended, in subsection [1) by inserting "or an officer of the Bureau" immediately after "officer" in the first line. of section 9.
Section 9 of the Act is amended, in subsection (2), by inserting "or an officer of the Bureau" immediately after "police" in the third line. of section 16A.

Section 16A of the Act is amended by repealing subsection (6). Made this 3rd. day of Jamadilawal, 1433 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of March, 2012 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM AWANG HAJI ZAKARIA BIN HAJI AHMAD, Pemangku Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam. B$5.00
